localCenters.name: Jain Center of America
localCenters.description: The oldest Jain temple in the Western Hemisphere, established in 1976. Serves a vibrant community of over 1,000 Jain families in the New York metro area.

localCenters.name: Jain Society of Greater Detroit
localCenters.description: A rapidly growing Jain community center serving over 300 families with temple services, Pathshala, and community events.

localCenters.name: Jain Society of Chicago
localCenters.description: Home to one of the largest Digambara-Svetambara temples in North America, serving a thriving Midwest Jain community.

localCenters.name: Jain Center of Northern California
localCenters.description: A beautiful temple in the San Francisco Bay Area serving over 500 families with daily worship, festivals, and Pathshala.

localCenters.name: Jain Center of Southern California
localCenters.description: One of the largest Jain centers in the United States, with extensive facilities for worship, education, and community gatherings.

localCenters.name: Jain Temple of London
localCenters.description: The premier Jain temple in the United Kingdom, serving a growing diaspora community with temple services, cultural events, and youth programs.

localCenters.name: Shree Jain Sangh
localCenters.description: Serving the historic Jain community of Leicester with traditional temple practices and interfaith community engagement.

localCenters.name: Jain Society of Toronto
localCenters.description: A vibrant Jain community center in one of the most diverse cities in the world, with daily temple worship and extensive community programs.

localCenters.name: Jain Mandir Singapore
localCenters.description: A stunning temple dedicated to Lord Adinath, serving as a spiritual oasis in the heart of the city-state.

localCenters.name: Shri Digamber Jain Mandir
localCenters.description: East Africa's largest Jain temple, serving an established Jain community with temple worship, Pathshala, and community seva.

onlineResources.name: Jainpedia
onlineResources.description: The most comprehensive online resource for Jain studies, featuring articles, manuscripts, images, and videos from the Institute of Jainology.

onlineResources.name: JAINA (Federation of Jain Associations)
onlineResources.description: The umbrella organization for Jain centers across North America. Provides resources, youth programs, and community coordination.

onlineResources.name: Jain Pathway
onlineResources.description: A comprehensive resource for Jain philosophy, ethics, and community with study guides and discussion forums.

onlineResources.name: Jain World
onlineResources.description: A major open-access resource for Jainism with thousands of articles on philosophy, history, and practice.

onlineResources.name: Jain E-Library
onlineResources.description: Online library with thousands of scanned books, Agama texts, and scholarly works available for free download.

onlineResources.name: Jain Vishva Bharati University
onlineResources.description: A premier Jain university in Ladnun, Rajasthan, offering courses in Jain studies, Prakrit, and philosophy. Online courses available.

onlineResources.name: HereNow4U
onlineResources.description: A leading Jain magazine and portal with articles, pravachanas, and community news from around the world.

onlineResources.name: Jain Sadhvi Blogs
onlineResources.description: Authentic spiritual guidance from Jain Sadhvis on topics ranging from daily practice to difficult modern dilemmas.

onlineResources.name: Pravachan Recordings
onlineResources.description: Thousands of pravachanas by eminent Acharyas and scholars, available in MP3 and video formats.

onlineResources.name: Jain Children's Network
onlineResources.description: Online games, stories, and learning activities for Jain children in the diaspora.

youthPrograms.name: Jain Youth Forum
youthPrograms.description: A global network for Jain teens and young adults to discuss philosophy, practice, and modern life challenges.

youthPrograms.name: Pathshala Online
youthPrograms.description: Virtual religious education for children and youth, covering Jain philosophy, stories, and practices.

youthPrograms.name: Jain Summer Camps
youthPrograms.description: Immersion camps where youth live the Jain path for a week — vegetarian food, meditation, hikes, and spiritual camaraderie.

youthPrograms.name: Essay & Debate Competitions
youthPrograms.description: Annual national and international competitions on Jain philosophy, ethics, and literature in English, Hindi, and Gujarati.

youthPrograms.name: Yoga & Meditation Retreats
youthPrograms.description: Weekend retreats combining Jain teachings with yoga, Preksha meditation, and community seva.

youthPrograms.name: Jain Heritage Tours
youthPrograms.description: Guided pilgrimages to India for youth to visit Jain temples, meet monks and nuns, and experience Jain history firsthand.

youthPrograms.name: Interfaith Dialogues
youthPrograms.description: Programs where Jain youth represent Jain values in interfaith settings, building bridges with other religious communities.

youthPrograms.name: Seva Projects
youthPrograms.description: Community service opportunities — food bank volunteering, elder care, environmental cleanup, and animal shelter seva.

sevaOpportunities.name: Temple Seva
sevaOpportunities.description: Help maintain temple cleanliness, organize festival events, prepare community meals (Bhojan), and assist elderly worshippers.

sevaOpportunities.name: Pathshala Teaching
sevaOpportunities.description: Volunteer as a teachers' aide or lead teacher for religious education classes for children and youth.

sevaOpportunities.name: Prakrit Classes
sevaOpportunities.description: Learn and teach the ancient Prakrit language to preserve Jain scriptural heritage for future generations.

sevaOpportunities.name: Animal Welfare
sevaOpportunities.description: Volunteer at animal shelters, bird hospitals, and cow protection shelters aligned with Ahimsa principles.

sevaOpportunities.name: Food for the Hungry
sevaOpportunities.description: Participate in community food drives and meal preparation for the homeless and hungry, following the principle of Aparigraha (non-possession through giving).

sevaOpportunities.name: Scripture Digitization
sevaOpportunities.description: Help digitize ancient Jain manuscripts and make them available in digital libraries for global access.

sevaOpportunities.name: Blood Drives
sevaOpportunities.description: Organize and participate in blood donation camps, an act of saving lives that aligns beautifully with Ahimsa.

sevaOpportunities.name: Environmental Seva
sevaOpportunities.description: Tree planting, river cleanup, and plastic reduction initiatives — modern applications of Ahimsa to nature.
